entities.name: NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit
observations: 768-aa query strongly matches reviewed NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit B/C/D; best reference A0LJM5 has 76.2% identity and 99.0% query coverage.
Homolog annotations assign the NDH-1 complex NADH-to-quinone electron transfer coupled to proton translocation; subunit-level standalone catalysis is not established.

entities.name: NADH:quinone proton-coupled reduction
observations: Rhea RHEA:57888: quinone + NADH + 5 H+(in) = quinol + NAD+ + 4 H+(out), according to the homologous NDH-1 complex annotation.
